rationale: Introduced model encrypt/decrypt helpers that treat only null as empty; undefined fields are sent to encryption. Older PR (2025), no description; baseline reconstruction is exact but review context thin.

known_defects.description: Model helpers skip only `null` fields; `undefined` fields are passed to the encryption operation
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that undefined/missing model field values are not handled like null and reach encryption, or produce an error/incorrect output.

known_defects.description: bulk model reconstruction splits the `${index}-${field}` key on every '-', so hyphenated field names are truncated and the encrypted value lands under the wrong key
known_defects.fixed_by: #548 (fixed in the stack copy; the protect copy was not changed)
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that hyphenated field keys are mis-parsed when bulk model results are reassembled, leaving values under the wrong key.
known_defects.added_reason: Found in an evaluator's finding during dev-split adjudication and confirmed by a later fix in the repository. Excluded from the pre-registered metrics; reported separately.
